If the center convention applies, retain the parent unchanged and identify a source-authorized remedy or hold the proposed B04 route; do not relocate T or repair the parent implicitly.

directorReadback.decision: DF218-B04 remains held; the preserved B4 parent does not prove DF9-Q23 clearance.
findings: The exact B4 case hash was verified; its positionFeet and bodySizeFeet fields do not state an XY anchor.
The bound Wizard18 physicalPremise declares a 5x5x6-foot occupied box but does not bind the positionFeet anchor.

The Sphere shared geometry rule requires declared bodies and anchors but supplies no default convention; DF9-Q23 requires Sphere boundary volume to avoid bodies and independent solids at establishment.

The conditional geometry values 10.143471 feet under center anchoring and 6.992138 feet under minimum-corner anchoring are correct; roster membership, placement=legal, and numeric replay do not substitute for full-body clearance.
directorReadback.requiredEvidence: An explicit authoritative clarification tied to the exact B4 case hash that identifies T’s coordinate anchor, followed by complete occupied-volume versus shell clearance verification.
directorReadback.statePreservation: No parent relocation, repair, fixture construction, witness construction, acceptance, application, or queue change.
